title: Piercing Frame Solo MaxMakeup #015 (맥시멀리스트 얼굴 컷 · P25 집중형 · 맥시멀리스트 · 피부톤 에보니 브라운 · 재질 얼굴만 · 체형 super hourglass · 금속 금 · 메이크업 인스타글램)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the base of her neck and the tops of her collarbones, the frame cutting off there. Her face is large and sharp. Mid 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a striking adult woman — DEEP EBONY BROWN SKIN, a rich dark complexion with warm brown undertones, early 30s goddess, super hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum beyond any proportion, most dramatic hourglass ratio ever recorded on any human body, thighs so thick pressing together, deep burgundy wine-red hair styled in a sleek wet-look slicked straight back. Real pores and fine skin grain on her skin, a soft sheen of natural oils, large eyes with bright real catchlights, full lips, heavily sculpted contour and a strong highlighter on the cheekbones, bold defined brows, long fluffy false lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, plump glossy nude lips with a defined lip-liner outline, a confident, camera-ready smile, a bold, commanding expression — a photograph of a real face, not an illustration, not a render. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light 

Piercings: All twenty-five piercings gather mostly on the left side of her face, and the right side stays almost bare: on the left ear eight pieces — a big yellow-gold segment ring in the lobe, three smaller yellow-gold rings above it, two thick yellow-gold bars and two small yellow-gold studs up to the top; one small yellow-gold stud sits in the right ear; four yellow-gold pieces in a row along the outer half of the left eyebrow, alternating small rings that pass through the brow skin with the skin visible through each loop and small round ball studs sitting on the skin; two small yellow-gold rings pass through the left nostril and a thick yellow-gold septum ring hangs below the nose; a yellow-gold hoop passes through the left edge of the lower lip with a yellow-gold snake-bite ring beside it and a small yellow-gold ring at the left edge of the upper lip; a yellow-gold Medusa stud sits above the lips; a yellow-gold labret stud and a small yellow-gold ring sit on the chin; three small yellow-gold studs run along the left jaw. Each piece carries small mixed gemstones (diamond, pearl, opal, amethyst, ruby and sapphire) set into alternating pieces. All jewelry is real yellow gold, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Lighting: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the glints on every piece of metal read clearly against her skin; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
